messages.content: These drafted Go tests could not run on the repository's main head; each carries its output. Rewrite each test so it compiles there and still fails for the feature's absence, keeping its id and its test name. Answer one JSON object: {"holdouts":[{"id","test_code"}]}.

The input, as JSON:
{"spec":{"outcome":"The counter counts every row the query returns, skipped ones included."},"failed":[{"id":"h1","test_name":"TestCounterSkips","test_code":"func TestCounterSkips(t *testing.T) {}","output":"fixture dry-run output: the test did not compile"}]}
